title: envelope key "telepathy" outside WireFrame's field list is refused as unknown-envelope-field
notes: source: WV-PORT-API-STALL-SUSPENDED-01, mutation: `{"telepathy":true,` spliced in right after the opening brace, before `"contractId"`. pinned-because-current ([WIR1-C16]): cite computenet-5zba and spec 42 §KE3-39 "Decision: the constraint stays operational — no mechanism"; additive compatibility runs one way only; the original [WIR1-I05] "SHALL ignore" described behaviour the codec never had (epic re-scope item 1). Observed kotlinx.serialization.json.internal.JsonDecodingException "Encountered an unknown key 'telepathy' at offset 2 at path: $". Dead-letter accounting on the receiving side is covered by wire/src/test/kotlin/civictech/wire/WsIngressDecodeFailureTest.kt, not retested here.
